newsitems.title: I might finally have gone too far with a GTA 5 mod that imports most of Doom 2
newsitems.author: Joshua Wolens
newsitems.contents: I really don't know how to build up to this one. Grand Theft Auto 5 is Doom now, okay? I put in a mod that imports DOOM2.wad into GTA 5 and now that's what the game is. There are demons. The game is first person. I have a minigun and a BFG. That's the truth of the matter and we're all just going to have to find some way to live with it... Read more.

newsitems.title: I have added roving bands of militant furries to Grand Theft Auto 5
newsitems.author: Joshua Wolens
newsitems.contents: Let's get one thing out of the way: I think we, as a society, as a people, are generally fine with furries at this point. The phenomenon of ragging on furry subculture has been, gladly, consigned to the dustbin of history. It's a 2010 disease from which we have convalesced. Let nothing I write from here on be taken as a slight against them... Read more.

newsitems.title: Help, I have been abducted by a tiny car and cannot escape
newsitems.author: Joshua Wolens
newsitems.contents: The diary of my time with Grand Theft Auto 5 so far consists, in the main, of struggles with cars. The perfidious automobile, the horseless carriage, has run rampant in Los Santos for weeks now, causing all manner of chaos as I attempt to live my life and do backflips and what-have-you... Read more.

newsitems.title: I've added scams to GTA 5, but I might have scammed myself
newsitems.author: Joshua Wolens
newsitems.contents: shift in the fabric of reality: I launch Grand Theft Auto 5 and, following the now-customary hitch-and-stutter loading screen that can last anywhere from 10 seconds to five minutes, Franklin spawns into his familiar void apartment. Within seconds, he begins plummeting, screaming... Read more.

newsitems.title: I am cavorting with a gazelle's grace in Grand Theft Auto 5
newsitems.author: Joshua Wolens
newsitems.contents: La Rochefoucauld once wrote, "What grace is to the body, good sense is to the mind." He wrote this some time before the release of Grand Theft Auto 5, and was likely referring to Mirror's Edge instead... Read more.

newsitems.title: Experience Halloween Thrills All Throughout October in GTA Online
newsitems.author: rockstarintl_steam
newsitems.contents:
The streets of Los Santos are crawling with creepy apparitions, paranormal visions, and more this Halloween season. Prepare for a month of ghastly mayhem with vengeful Slashers roaming the streets and tides of shambling undead occupying Ludendorff Cemetery.

Hunt down spooky visions of deceased tech executives for Ghosts Exposed and make a killing across the Halloween Featured Series, the kill-or-be-killed tension of Slasher, racing in the San Andreas Super Sport Series, or fighting off the forces of evil in Halloween Survivals. Plus, keep an eye out for Peyote Plants growing across Southern San Andreas to experience life from a whole new perspective. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45517848/c6fe37d8c7b605a4ab166fa6cad77b45a00c4c8c.jpg[/img]

WORK THE NIGHT SHIFT FOR BONUS REWARDS

Step up and fight back against the shrouded agents of chaos lurking out there in the darkness. Apprehending Standard and Most Wanted Bail Office Targets or helping Vincent Effenburger clean up the streets in Dispatch Work will earn you 2X GTA$ and RP all October long.

Plus, tear through Random Transform Races and high-speed Hotring chaos for 3X GTA$ and RP in the San Andreas Super Sport Series.

GET HALLOWEEN TREATS FOR COMPLETING WEEKLY CHALLENGES

Completing increasingly difficult Weekly Challenges throughout October will earn you special spooky gifts and cash rewards — with an extra GTA$2,000,000 bonus (delivered within 72 hours of completion) for achieving them all:

- October 1–7: Secure two Bail Office Bounties to get the Green Vintage Skull Mask and GTA$100,000 
- October 8–14: Win in two Adversary modes to get the Pink Skull Emissive Mask and GTA$100,000 
- October 15–21: Win three Races to get the Orange Glow Skeleton Onesie and GTA$100,000 
- October 22–28: Complete all waves of a Survival to get the Gray Space Interloper Outfit and GTA$150,000 
- October 29–November 4: Complete 10 waves in a Survival without dying to get the Slasher Clown Outfit and GTA$250,000 

3X GTA$ AND RP FOR HALLOWEEN SURVIVALS

The Ludendorff Cemetery Survival rises again this October, bringing waves of fearsome foes and haunted animals to bear down on frosty North Yankton.

All Halloween Survivals — including Alien Survivals, Cayo Perico Survival, and the ghastly Ludendorff Cemetery Survival — are awarding 3X GTA$ and RP.

newsitems.title: GTA 6 writer says the series has never had "much focus on national politics" beyond GTA 4's war on terror, and the latest entry won't get "too specific"
newsitems.contents:
Details about and dev chatter concerning GTA 6 continue to drip out as part of the marketing push towards its console launch in November. This time, some of the aspects of it I'm most intrigued to see how Rockstar have handled whenever they deign to bring it to PC have been discussed - how they've approached satirising the societal climate of America in 2026 through allusions to politics and the American dream.

Read more

newsitems.title: I added October-appropriate zombies to Grand Theft Auto 5
newsitems.author: Joshua Wolens
newsitems.contents: There is no more room in hell—the dead are at the beach. Grand Theft Auto 5, already burdened and bedraggled by the parade of mods I have inflicted on it, must now contend with a new disorder: revenants from beyond the veil... Read more.

newsitems.title: Grand Theft Auto 5 is a game about shapeshifting now. I don't make the rules
newsitems.author: Joshua Wolens
newsitems.contents: Disregard that other thing I said. Grand Theft Auto 5 no longer only launches in windowed mode. It now only launches in fullscreen mode. We're choosing not to investigate this and are just hoping the whole thing works itself out... Read more.

newsitems.title: I have saved GTA 5 from death and also added tornadoes
newsitems.author: Joshua Wolens
newsitems.contents: Sometimes you have to roll up your sleeves and do what's necessary. No sentimentality, no squeamishness—just pure, solution-oriented bluesky thinking. This philosophy once guided Maximilien de Robespierre and now it guides me, in my equally epochal struggle to simply make Grand Theft Auto 5 boot in spite of the vast cargo of mods I have now encumbered it with... Read more.

newsitems.title: My GTA 5 install has a death wish but I have soothed it with flossing
newsitems.author: Joshua Wolens
newsitems.contents: There is an anxiety to my movements now. The stench of death lingers about Grand Theft Auto 5 like petrichor after hard, hot rain, and I am nervous that any addition will finally nudge it over the edge... Read more.

newsitems.title: I have broken GTA 5 by installing so many mods that the game only launches in windowed mode now
newsitems.author: Joshua Wolens
newsitems.contents: Can a game go on life support? Can it begin, in its dotage, to show signs of the ailment that everyone knows—but would never say—is the thing that will one day bring it down for good?.. Read more.

newsitems.title: I made the hot dog vendors in GTA 5 work because Rockstar never did
newsitems.author: Joshua Wolens
newsitems.contents: I have filled a yawning void in the soul of Los Santos. I have returned the heart to a heartless world. I am a teacher, a healer, a gardener of human happiness. My efforts have ensured the general flourishing of society and the wellbeing of the spaceship Earth... Read more.

newsitems.title: My greatest GTA 5 challenge yet: Random teleports every 50 seconds
newsitems.author: Joshua Wolens
newsitems.contents: It's the greatest challenge I've yet faced. Not in Grand Theft Auto 5, in life (I was a sheltered child). Forget hit squads, forget running a billion-dollar privacy-invading company, forget bad credit, forget the absence of gravity. My enemy now is space itself, the third dimension. Maybe spacetime. Never been clear on what that is... Read more.

newsitems.title: I put UFO sightings in Grand Theft Auto 5, though it didn't quite go to plan
newsitems.author: Joshua Wolens
newsitems.contents: Every nation has its kooks—excepting of course the Swiss—but there's something utterly American to me about the UFO sighting. It's probably something to do with the sheer size of the place. A tired, potentially hopped-up trucker, trundling across the endless plains of… whatever state has endless plains in it, spying something mysterious and illuminated in the canopy above? That's America to me... Read more.

newsitems.title: I modded Crazy Taxi into Grand Theft Auto 5
newsitems.author: Joshua Wolens
newsitems.contents: Have you heard? Crazy Taxi is coming back. As a game, yes (with some rather off-putting gen-AI mixed in there), and also as a movie. You may have heard this. What you have not heard is that I, personally, am bringing Crazy Taxi back. I am bringing it back to Los Santos, to Grand Theft Auto 5... Read more.

newsitems.title: GTA 5 has true air travel now thanks to the mod I just installed, but they won't let me give me my pals piggybacks onto the plane
newsitems.author: Joshua Wolens
newsitems.contents: It might feel minnowish compared to modern open worlds, but Los Santos is still a schlep to get across. Whether you're on a bike, in a car, or hoofing it on-foot, it takes a while to get from the city itself out to the northernmost boonies. Well, no more... Read more.

newsitems.title: Ahead of GTA 6, Rockstar warn modders against making unofficial main story expansions, unauthorised ports and mods that combine GTA maps
newsitems.contents:
There still might not yet be a release date for GTA 6's PC port, but Rockstar appear to be preparing for the massive uptick in mods for their games that'll inevitably accompany it. In new modding guidelines posted this month, the studio have expressly warned against a bunch of things modders could do, including building on established storylines from the base game, pulling over bits of older GTAs, and porting the game to platforms it's not hit yet.

Read more

newsitems.title: I have modded the most exciting thing possible into GTA 5: Hard and soft credit checks and realistic personal finance
newsitems.author: Joshua Wolens
newsitems.contents: In a previous life, long before I began making millions writing about videogames professionally, I wrote marketing copy for a finance firm I still don't really understand. Do you know the fine art of embedding payment iframes in customer payment gateways? I did. Once. Do you know the riotous history of the SWIFT international banking system? What about SEPA? No? What a sheltered life you must lead... Read more.
